description: Groundwork dependency updates use the daily self-hosted runner in jasondockery/renovate-config. The frozen shared preset currently owns the weekly routine update/branch window but has a known effective npm-age discrepancy; the corrected strict five-day normal-update and explicit security-bypass policy is approved in principle, not active. Pins, digests, and manual surfaces use the controls in dependency-coverage.json. The canonical end-to-end acceptance contract lives at renovate-config/specs/renovate-system-acceptance.md.

Groundwork's managed surfaces are GitHub Actions SHA pins, Dockerfile image tags/digests, the tagged-and-digested Gitleaks workflow container, and declared Python versions in the managed mise configuration. Only groundwork-specific rules stay local; the wider non-major group below includes digest and pin updates because several surfaces are immutable pins, not semver ranges. A green runner scan is not Groundwork compatibility proof — an eligible PR must pass Groundwork CI.
